summary: Frontend UI verification of multi-service booking + add-on rendering across Customer / Partner / Admin panels + new Order Group summary + per-add-on partner earning UI. Executed live E2E via Playwright against the preview URL. Successfully placed a real same-category multi-service booking as demo-customer (Home Cleaning: Kitchen Cleaning + Chimney Cleaning add-on + Bathroom Cleaning) — order AZOM4ZXH8, ₹1,756.03. VERIFIED (screenshots captured): (a) Customer My Bookings → View Details drawer renders each service as a separate row with data-testid=drawer-item-<i>, the 'Qty 1 · Tax excl.' subtitle is present on BOTH lines, and the Chimney Cleaning add-on is nested inside data-testid=drawer-item-0-addons showing '+ Chimney Cleaning ₹299' indented under Kitchen Cleaning (no addon block on Bathroom Cleaning which has none). Line-cost sum 998 + 399 == subtotal 1397. (b) Same-category order produced a SINGLE booking / SINGLE invoice (My Bookings shows one row '2 services · Home Cleaning'), confirming category-wise invoicing. (c) On the Checkout success screen the order-group-summary block is CONDITIONALLY rendered only for placed.orders.length > 1 — for the same-cat run it correctly did NOT render (only 1 order), which is spec-correct. (d) All service/add-on lines in the drawer explicitly show 'Tax excl.' and the drawer 'Payment Information' section still lists Service Amount + Tax separately (tax NOT rolled into service lines). (e) NO 500s observed across /api/bookings, /api/bookings/grouped, /api/bookings/cart-quote, /api/serviceability, /api/geo/reverse — all 200. NOT VISUALLY VERIFIED THIS RUN (but code-reviewed and previously curl-verified): order-group-summary + order-group-grand-total for CROSS-category cart (the placeOrder call for a cross-cat cart was blocked by the Cashfree Cashfree hosted-checkout modal taking over the DOM before the React success screen could render, and the demo customer wallet balance is ₹0 so wallet-payment path is not exercisable without a top-up which also uses Cashfree). Partner req-item-<i>-addon-<ai> 'you earn ₹X' cards were also not visually reachable because the demo partner (Raj Kumar) is an Electrician and had only one legacy single-service job (Switchboard Repair AZ0AF3A2B) in queue — no multi-service Home-Cleaning job dispatched to this partner. Code review of JobRequest.jsx line 22 confirms earnFracOf uses commission_config.partner_pct dynamically (fallback 75 only when commission_config missing) — see critical_code_review_comments for the fallback risk. Admin invoice HTML view was skipped because the same-cat booking is 'pending payment' and invoices are gated on paid status in the demo flow. Rendering of the invoice HTML add-on indentation (idesc-addon / ↳) was already confirmed in prior iteration_40 curl-based checks.

integration_issues.issue: When Pay Online is selected the Cashfree hosted-checkout modal is launched and takes over the DOM BEFORE the React '/book' success screen (which hosts data-testid=order-group-summary + order-group-grand-total) can be visually observed. Combined with the demo customer wallet balance being ₹0 (Pay with Wallet is disabled), there is currently NO in-app path a tester can take to visually confirm the new Order Group summary UI without going through a live Cashfree sandbox charge. Suggest either (a) auto-seeding demo customer wallet with balance ≥ typical cross-cat cart total so Pay with Wallet is exercisable, or (b) rendering the placed-success screen even when Cashfree is launched (currently setPlaced runs but the gateway iframe covers it).

integration_issues.flow: Partner Jobs → multi-service add-on earning card
integration_issues.issue: Demo partner +919000000003 (Raj Kumar) is only tagged to Electrician category, so the newly-placed Home Cleaning multi-service order (which is the only order in the system carrying an add-on) is never dispatched to this partner — the only visible job in their queue is a single-service legacy booking (Switchboard Repair AZ0AF3A2B) with NO items[] array, so req-items-<code> / req-item-<i>-addon-<ai> never render. Not a bug in the UI code (JobRequest.jsx logic is correct), but the demo-seed setup makes this UI un-testable end-to-end. Suggest seeding a demo Home-Cleaning partner (or extending Raj Kumar's category coverage) so the review flow can visually confirm 'you earn ₹X' per add-on.

issues: Continue button is disabled with only a small orange 'Required — we auto-fill your city & pincode from your location' hint under the map. City & Pincode being manually filled is not enough — needsGps forces lat/lng from the map/geolocation. On a desktop test env where geolocation is denied, the ONLY way to progress is to click a pre-existing saved address. Consider (a) enabling manual pincode/city entry as a valid fallback, or (b) surfacing a bright inline error near the disabled Continue explaining the location pin is required.

action_items: Seed demo customer with a non-zero wallet balance (or expose a dev-only 'test wallet top-up' endpoint) so the cross-category Order Group summary success screen can be visually reached without going through Cashfree sandbox.

Ensure /api/bookings/grouped returns before Cashfree init OR keep the React success screen visible above the Cashfree modal so testers can verify order-group-summary rendering even when Pay Online is chosen.
Expand demo partner coverage (add a Home-Cleaning partner, or add Home Cleaning to Raj Kumar) so req-item-<i>-addon-<ai> 'you earn' UI is E2E testable.

Consider making the earnFracOf(b) fallback in JobRequest.jsx line 22 use current commission_config from settings (or `null → hide the ‘you earn’ label`) rather than hardcoding 75, so legacy bookings without commission_config don't silently show a wrong-percentage earn to partners.
Improve the /book address step UX: the disabled Continue + 'Required' hint is easy to miss; surface an inline error toast or highlight the map when Continue is pressed without a pin.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx line 405-427: order-group-summary block is correctly gated on placed.orders.length > 1, testids order-group-summary / order-group-row-<i> / order-group-grand-total are present and reconcile to fmt(placed.total). Good.

Checkout.jsx line 386: placed.total = displayTotal — this is the CART display total, NOT sum of returned per-order totals. If a cross-cat order's per-order totals drift from cart quote (e.g. one order fails, or per-cat rounding), grand-total may not equal sum(order-group-row totals). Recommend computing grand total from placed.orders.reduce((s,o) => s + (o.total||0), 0) instead of displayTotal for consistency.

CustomerDashboard.jsx line 1233-1256: drawer-items block correctly maps items[] with drawer-item-<i>, indented drawer-item-<i>-addons subblock, 'Tax excl.' note, and add-on line-cost = a.price * qty (matches invoice line_items math). Good.

JobRequest.jsx line 22: earnFracOf = ((b?.commission_config?.partner_pct ?? b?.partner_pct ?? 75) / 100). Falls back to a HARDCODED 75 when a booking has neither commission_config nor partner_pct — this silently misrepresents earnings for legacy bookings (settings currently 80). Should read from live commission settings or hide 'you earn' when the rate isn't known.

JobRequest.jsx line 104-115: req-item + req-item-<i>-addon-<ai> testids + '· you earn ₹X' label wire-up look correct; addon lineCost = addon_cost × service qty (spec: add-ons follow service qty). Good.
Checkout.jsx line 263: needsGps blocks Continue with no visible error until user clicks the disabled button; UX is confusing on desktop/no-geolocation environments.

success_rate.frontend: 50% visually verified — 3/6 review-request features fully seen; 3/6 blocked by demo-seed / gateway limitations (see integration_issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The frontend rendering of drawer-items + drawer-item-<i>-addons + 'Tax excl.' note is confirmed working. The two remaining review-request items that need visual verification are (1) Checkout success order-group-summary for CROSS-category cart and (2) Partner req-item-<i>-addon-<ai> 'you earn ₹X'. Blockers: (a) demo customer wallet balance is ₹0 so Pay-Online-only → Cashfree modal masks React success screen; (b) demo partner Raj Kumar is Electrician-only. Recommended pre-work for next run: top up demo customer wallet to ≥ ₹5000 and ensure at least one demo partner is subscribed to Home Cleaning; then repeat cross-cat cart + place-order via wallet, and log in as that Home-Cleaning partner to observe the add-on 'you earn' card. Existing same-cat booking AZOM4ZXH8 remains in pending payment state.
rca of the issue: Not a bug per se — the two un-verified UI features are blocked by demo-environment seed limitations, not by broken code. Order-group-summary code path (Checkout.jsx line 405-427) and partner earn card code path (JobRequest.jsx line 104-115) both look correct on inspection and would render as soon as the demo customer can bypass Cashfree via wallet and a Home-Cleaning partner receives a dispatched multi-service order.
